observations: A red, two-door refrigerator with the brand 'Hisense' visible on the top door in photo 0 and photo 1.
The fridge has a glossy finish and appears to be in a home setting, placed on a wooden stand or pallet.
Photo 2 shows the lower fridge compartment open, revealing empty shelves, a water dispenser on the door, and a plastic bag inside.
No visible damage to the exterior in the photos, but reflections and lighting make it hard to assess scratches or dents.
No interior of the freezer compartment is shown.
No receipt, carton, or accessories are visible in any photo.
The seller claims 'few months used' and that 'receipt, carton and everything accessories available' — none are shown.
